t: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Co Company Profile - Overview - GlobalData
s: Scotts Miracle-Gro markets its products under the Roundup, Gro Pro, Scotts, Miracle-Gro, Titan, Ortho, Gavita, Earthgro, Hyponex, General Hydroponics, Turf Builder, Home Defense, and Tomcat brand names. It serves warehouse clubs, home centers, mass merchandisers, independent hardware stores, nurseries, large hardware chains, garden centers, food and drug stores, e-commerce platforms, indoor gardening, and hydroponic product distributors, growers, and retailers. The company sells its products through a network of direct sales force, online stores, brokers, and distributors.

About Scotts Scotts is the market leader in lawn care, inspiring people to spend more time outside in their yards while providing innovative solutions and educational guidance to maintain their lawns as they see fit.
